import json,hashlib,time,signal,resource,math
from pathlib import Path
from itertools import combinations
import sympy as s
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/CLASSIFICATION_UNIMODULAR_POLE_EIGHT_MPS_FIXED_QUADRATIC_JETS_20261108.json';assert not out.exists()
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(1024*1024**2,1024*1024**2));signal.alarm(60)
start=time.monotonic();job=json.loads((root/'research/classification/jobs/unimodular_pole_eight_mps_fixed_quadratic_jets.json').read_text())
for rec in job['exact_inputs_and_hashes']:assert hashlib.sha256((root/rec['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==rec['sha256'],rec['path']
x=s.symbols('x0:5');v=s.symbols('v0:4');pars=s.symbols('p0 p1 p2 p3 t0 t1 t2 t3');env={str(z):z for z in x+pars}
fixed=[('T24',2),('T26',0),('T27',0),('T31',0),('T32',0),('T33',3),('T34',0),('T35',0)]
records=[]
for name,q in fixed:
 path='reports/MPS_SMOOTHING_COMPLETION_20261103_v62/'+name+'.json'
 if not (root/path).exists():path='reports/MPS_S61_RAW_CATALOGUE_20261103_v62/'+name+'.json'
 data=json.loads((root/path).read_text());P=s.zeros(5)
 for key,value in data['homogeneous_bivector'].items():
  i,j=map(int,key.split(','));P[i,j]=s.sympify(value,locals=env);P[j,i]=-P[i,j]
 inds=[i for i in range(5)if i!=q];sub={x[q]:1,**dict(zip([x[i]for i in inds],v))};Q=s.zeros(4);aff=s.zeros(4)
 for a,b in combinations(range(4),2):
  i,j=inds[a],inds[b];f=s.expand((P[i,j]-x[i]*P[q,j]+x[j]*P[q,i]).subs(sub))
  poly=s.Poly(f,*v);low=[s.cancel(c)for ex,c in poly.terms()if sum(ex)<2];assert all(z==0 for z in low),(name,'not order2zero')
  f2=s.Add(*(c*s.prod(z**k for z,k in zip(v,ex))for ex,c in poly.terms()if sum(ex)==2));Q[a,b]=s.factor(f2);Q[b,a]=-Q[a,b];aff[a,b]=f;aff[b,a]=-f
 alpha=[]
 for a in range(4):
  i,j,k=[b for b in range(4)if b!=a];alpha.append(s.factor((-1)**a*(v[i]*Q[j,k]-v[j]*Q[i,k]+v[k]*Q[i,j])))
 pf=s.factor(Q[0,1]*Q[2,3]-Q[0,2]*Q[1,3]+Q[0,3]*Q[1,2])
 rec={'component':name,'source_path':path,'marked_coordinate_zero':q,'all_source_parameters_symbolic':True,'order0_and1_zero_identically':True,'quadratic_jet':{str(i)+','+str(j):str(Q[i,j])for i,j in combinations(range(4),2)},'cubic_alpha':list(map(str,alpha)),'Pf_Q':str(pf)}
 if pf==0 or all(f==0 for f in alpha):
  rec['status']='UNRESOLVED_ZERO_PF_OR_ALPHA';records.append(rec);continue
 field=s.QQ.frac_field(*pars);coeff,fact=s.Poly(pf,*v,domain=field).factor_list();factors=[ff.as_expr()for ff,mult in fact];mults=[int(mult)for ff,mult in fact]
 rec['Pf_factorization']={'scalar':str(coeff),'factors':list(map(str,factors)),'multiplicities':mults}
 lam=s.symbols('lambda0:'+str(len(factors)));basis=[[s.cancel(pf/ff*s.diff(ff,z))for z in v]for ff in factors]
 eq=[]
 for j in range(4):
  pol=s.Poly(s.expand(sum(lam[i]*basis[i][j]for i in range(len(factors)))-alpha[j]),*v)
  eq.extend(c for ex,c in pol.terms()if c!=0)
 mat,rhs=s.linear_eq_to_matrix(eq,lam);sol=s.linsolve((mat,rhs),lam)
 if sol is s.EmptySet or len(sol)!=1:
  rec['status']='UNRESOLVED_NO_LOG_RESIDUE_IDENTITY';records.append(rec);continue
 values=tuple(map(s.cancel,next(iter(sol))))
 if any(val.free_symbols.intersection(set(lam))for val in values):
  rec['status']='UNRESOLVED_NONUNIQUE_LOG_RESIDUES';records.append(rec);continue
 assert all(s.cancel(sum(values[i]*basis[i][j]for i in range(len(factors)))-alpha[j])==0 for j in range(4))
 rec['all_log_residue_coefficient_identities_zero']=True;rec['log_residues']=list(map(str,values))
 ref=next((vv for vv in values if vv!=0),None)
 if ref is None:
  rec['status']='UNRESOLVED_ZERO_LOG_RESIDUES';records.append(rec);continue
 ratios=[s.cancel(val/ref)for val in values];rec['residue_ratios']=list(map(str,ratios))
 if not all(rat.is_Rational for rat in ratios):
  rec['status']='UNRESOLVED_NONRATIONAL_CONSTANT_RATIO';records.append(rec);continue
 lcm=s.ilcm(*[int(z.q)for z in ratios]);exps=[int(lcm*z)for z in ratios];g=math.gcd(*exps);exps=[i//g for i in exps]
 num=s.prod(ff**i for ff,i in zip(factors,exps)if i>0);den=s.prod(ff**(-i)for ff,i in zip(factors,exps)if i<0)
 num=s.expand(num);den=s.expand(den);dnum=s.Poly(num,*v).total_degree();dden=s.Poly(den,*v).total_degree();assert dnum==dden and dnum>=1
 om=[s.expand(den*s.diff(num,z)-num*s.diff(den,z))for z in v];assert any(z!=0 for z in om)
 wedges=[s.expand(alpha[i]*om[j]-alpha[j]*om[i])for i,j in combinations(range(4),2)];assert all(z==0 for z in wedges)
 rec.update(status='WHOLE_GENERIC_SOURCE_BOUNDED_RATIONAL_FIRST_INTEGRAL_CERTIFIED',integer_exponents=exps,first_integral_numerator=str(num),first_integral_denominator=str(den),fixed_homogeneous_degree=dnum,all_six_alpha_wedge_first_integral_identities_zero=True,first_integral_nonconstant=True,whole_closure_method='Proper marked order2zero plus Gr(2,Sym^d) wedge incidence, including common factors; all parameter walls retained by closure')
 records.append(rec)
report={'task_id':'E_multiple_hyperplane','all_prescribed_cases_processed':len(records)==8,'source_scope':'All original true source parameters; only fixed coordinate order2zero readback, no Poisson source points/operator/rank/minor/profile/Jacobi recomputation','cases':records,'all_cases_certified':all(rr['status']=='WHOLE_GENERIC_SOURCE_BOUNDED_RATIONAL_FIRST_INTEGRAL_CERTIFIED'for rr in records),'new_components':0,'independent_review_required':True,'input_sha256':job['exact_inputs_and_hashes'],'executed_source_bytes':job['inline_source'],'executed_source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(job['inline_source'].encode()).hexdigest(),'seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'maximum_RSS_KiB':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss}
signal.alarm(0)
